installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
cd /tmp
curl -sSL -o mta.tar.gz https://linux.multitheftauto.com/dl/multitheftauto_linux_x64.tar.gz
curl -sSL -o baseconfig.tar.gz https://linux.multitheftauto.com/dl/baseconfig.tar.gz
curl -sSL -o resources.zip https://mirror.multitheftauto.com/mtasa/resources/mtasa-resources-latest.zip
mkdir -p /mnt/server
tar -xf mta.tar.gz
cp -r multitheftauto_linux_x64/* /mnt/server/
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/x64/libmysqlclient.so.16 ]; then
curl -L http://nightly.mtasa.com/files/libmysqlclient.so.16 -o /mnt/server/x64/libmysqlclient.so.16
fi
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/resources
unzip -qo resources.zip -d /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/resources
tar -xf baseconfig.tar.gz
cp -r baseconfig/* /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods/deathmatch/resource-cache/http-client-files
curl -sSL -o /mnt/server/start.sh http://panel.tridentsky.net/[repotridentsky]/start.sh
chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed - Trident Sky"
echo "MySQL + FastDL Ready"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
